name: deliveries
description: Parcels, food and errands carried across town.

maxKg.description: The heaviest load taken, in kilograms.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow and releases when the recipient has it. Done is the parcel handed over, and the seller records the delivery in their folder. A timer to the seller, set past the delivery, pays if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, say the size and weight.
